title: GatewayCall
description: One call across the Go/Python boundary: the request body of /ztax.gateway.v1.ModelGateway/Invoke (ADR-0006 §2.1; JSON codec recorded in intelligence/README.md, "The transport"). It carries the full governance context so the Gateway decides on the same facts the Go pre-check saw (§2.5); the pre-check's verdict is never sent. The input is opaque to the Gateway's governance step and is read only after authorise permits the call.
$comment: Go: backend/internal/adapter/gateway/grpc.go (wireCall). Python: ztax_gateway.wire.decode_call. Both are tested against this schema.

input_b64.description: The canonical-form input, base64. Opaque on the wire; never logged.
